description: This file defines the ChartDAO class for data access operations related to chart slices in the Superset project, including filtering, retrieving, and managing favorites.

classes.name: ChartDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object for chart slices, providing methods for filtering, retrieving by ID or UUID, and managing favorites.

methods.name: get_filterable_columns_and_operators
methods.description: Returns filterable columns and operators, including custom chart fields.

methods.name: get_by_id_or_uuid
methods.description: Retrieves a chart slice by its ID or UUID, raising an error if not found.

methods.name: favorited_ids
methods.description: Returns a list of favorite star object IDs for given charts.

methods.name: add_favorite
methods.description: Adds a chart to the user's favorites.

methods.name: remove_favorite
methods.description: Removes a chart from the user's favorites.
